name: adbc_scanner
description: Connect DuckDB to any database with an Arrow Database Connectivity (ADBC) driver — SQLite, PostgreSQL, Snowflake, Flight SQL, and more — using Arrow's columnar wire format end to end. Read, write, and inspect remote schemas without round-tripping through CSV/Parquet.

cta.title: Talk to Any ADBC-Speaking Database
cta.description: Install ADBC Scanner to query, mutate, and inspect external databases through their ADBC drivers — Arrow-native, zero-serialization, broad ecosystem support.

quickStart.title: Connect to SQLite via its ADBC driver
Run a query — result is a regular DuckDB table
quickStart.sql:
SET VARIABLE conn = (SELECT adbc_connect({'driver':'sqlite', 'uri':':memory:'}));
SELECT * FROM adbc_scan(getvariable('conn')::BIGINT, 'SELECT * FROM my_table');

quickStart.title: Run DDL / DML on the remote database
quickStart.sql:
SET VARIABLE conn = (SELECT adbc_connect({'driver':'sqlite', 'uri':':memory:'}));
SELECT adbc_execute(getvariable('conn')::BIGINT, 'CREATE TABLE users(id INT, name TEXT)');
